physical: For an ergodic system the long-time average of an observable equals its average over the ensemble of accessible states.
reflected_sentence: An average of a reading across Expansion equals the average of that reading over the states open to it.
rule_reason: Identity; cost block empty; no resistance-cost and no separation made by distance. Time's partner is Expansion.
interpretation: The identity keeps across Expansion. The equality of the two averages does not turn. Movement and the gap do not enter.
closing: The rule decided the shape on its own: an identity with an empty cost block keeps. Time has a partner, Expansion, so that term reflects and the equality stays an equality. I did not carry 'long' across as a magnitude, because nothing on this side has a quantity; that was a choice about the sentence, not about the shape. No separation made by distance is recorded.
